book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: N'yɛyɛ kune ki muh kuŋ bɛ kwɛse
Jiso jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ wu mɛsɛ, wu mo wu ja kimbe ki woŋ kì Galalee le, wu gɛɛŋ a kì Judia le, Joo yì Jodaŋ le wuŋ kwege.
No wu gɛnɛ, binchvu bi bamii baanyi bi bi wu le, wu fɛ bo bachii ba gɛ̀ chɛne yo.
Bafalashii ja bo to fɛ wu le ki bo moŋ wu, bo mo bo biih wu le lɛ, “Nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ taŋlo muh kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ yi fiɛɛ le kɛnɛ nyu fì la lɛ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ baaŋ a tɛɛŋ gɛ fiɛɛ fì ba gɛ̀ saŋ wa lɛ, ‘Gɛ̀ bee fɛŋkɛɛ muh wù gɛ̀ fɛ bamii, wu gɛ̀ fɛ bo nyu jwɛŋsɛ bɛ kwɛse gɛ?’
Wu gɛ̀ fɛ noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Le nje finɛ fì jwɛŋsɛ lé wu gê wu chinɛ chiji bɛ bwee le, wu taashɛ bɛ kwɛɛ, bo bafɛɛ mo bo tu wa muh wu mumwaa.’
Noo, gɛ bo baaŋ bamii bafɛɛ gɛ, bo le wa muh wu mumwaa. Fi mo fi nyu lɛ, fiɛɛ fì Nyo le wu taashɛ wa, keefɛ muh moŋ ki wu gâsɛ gɛ.”

content: Bamii baa mo bo biih Jiso le lɛ, “Tu le nje la fì Musɛ gɛ̀ duu lɛ muh taŋlo wu saŋ ŋwa wu nya kwɛɛ le wù duunyi lɛ wu le wu kuŋ wa bɛ wu, wu mo wu kuŋ bɛ wu?”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ̀ bee nje bintuŋ biɛna bì tɛmɛ wù Musɛ gɛ̀ chinɛ lɛ muh taŋlo wu kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ. Geenɛ, gɛ nyu no fi gɛ̀ bee fɛŋkɛɛ gɛ.
Njɛme fiaŋ bɛŋ le lɛ, muh ja wu kuŋ bɛ kwɛɛ wu jo wumu, baaŋ nyu gɛ lɛ kwɛse wɛɛ le wu ja wu tu wu jiɛnyi wu jaŋe kinjaŋ sɛŋ gɛ, tu wu le wu ge kimbefɛ njɛ ki wu jâŋ kwɛse wumu.”

content: Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo yu wunɛ njɛme bo mo bo du wu le lɛ, “Nɛ fi le noo kune jwɛŋsɛ bɛ kwɛse, tu fi be joŋe lɛ muh mɛ fie noo fɛ wu taashɛ bvuguu gɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ nyu muh wuchii wù taŋlo wu bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ finɛ gɛ. Taŋlo bɛɛŋ gɛh bamii ba Nyo le wu ge lɛ bo bɛɛŋ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii bamu le yu bo goone gɛ bikɛse gɛ, le no ba gɛ̀ boyɛ bo, bo nyume noo. Bamu nyu noo ge bamii bɛ chiaaŋ lɛ bo nyume noo. Bamu nyu fiboo noo ge bo bɛ bikwɛɛ biboo lɛ bo nyume noo nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe. Muh wù taŋlo wu bɛ̂ɛŋ finɛ, wu bɛ̂ɛŋ.”

content: Jiso noŋ kimbonɛ yi booŋ ba shige shige le
Bamii ja bo too bɛ booŋ fɛ Jiso le lɛ wu kuŋ bo le, wu buunɛ fɛ bo le, booŋ be ba ŋgoo tu bo wame lo bamii baa.
Jiso jɛmɛ fie lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ chinɛ booŋ bayu too fɛ mɛne. Keefɛ bɛŋ jêese bo gɛ, nje bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le nyu fɛ bamii ba le njɛ booŋ banɛ le.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu gɛɛ chiaaŋ yi bo le, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛne.
Jiso bɛ muh wu kwa
Fi kooshɛ lɛ muh wu kwa wumu gɛ̀ ja wu to fɛ Jiso le, wu biih wu le lɛ, “Muh wù N'yɛyɛ, fiɛɛ fì joŋe fì ŋkɛme ki ŋge fɛ ŋkɛmɛ kinche kì kage gɛ le la?”
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo biide nyu mɛne kune fiɛɛ fì joŋe nje la? Muh wù joŋe mɛ gɛh wu wù maa. Nɛ wo goone ki wo gê wo kɛmɛ kinche kì kage gɛ, wo mo wo gɛɛde banchi ba Nyo.”

content: Muh wuyu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Banchi ba Nyo le ba la?” Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Keefɛ wo yûuyɛ muh gɛ, keefɛ wo jâŋ kwɛ muh gɛ, keefɛ wo chôŋ bvuchoŋ gɛ, keefɛ wo bɛ̂ɛ jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ gɛ,
wo ŋgvûune chijo bɛ bwoo, bɛ lɛ wo kôŋe muh wù mbebe yo le.”

content: Chumu wɛɛ mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Banchi banɛ bachii nchi gɛɛde wa lo. Ka shɛshi la?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ wo fɛnɛ goone ki wo nyûme muh wù joŋe wu gɛɛne wu mɛɛse, wo gɛɛŋ wo gesɛ mwɛɛ mu wo kɛme, wo ga bige biyu ba fuude le, wo mo wo ge wo kɛ̂me nchvu yo nyu yi fɛwe. Wo nɛ lé wo gê noo wo mo wo to wo bîi mɛne.”

content: Sege chumu wuyu yu noo, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛne wu nyume lo yii yii, nje wu gɛ̀ kɛme kwa baaŋ.
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, fi tɛɛme fɛ muh wu kwa lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvù fɛwe le.
Ŋka nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, fi le chige fɛ nyambala lee a jise chi nsala le, fede fɛ muh wu kwa lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.”

content: Sege booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo yu finɛ fiɛɛ, jwe yuŋ bo baaŋ. Bo biih lɛ, “Nɛ finɛ le noo, yu to bonɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso bijɛ bo nɛɛ, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ le fɛ muh wu wuŋ le, tu fi taŋlo fi ya. Geenɛ fɛ Nyo le gɛ fiɛɛ taŋlo fi ya wu gɛ.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, bee le be chinɛ wa fiɛɛ fichii, be bii wo le. Bee lé be gê be kɛme la?”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ sege muh wu jee che le Mwamuh le wu shii wa yi kala we wu bvukugɛ bvu yi woŋ wu fwɛŋ le, bɛŋ banɛ ba gɛ̀ bii mɛne, bɛŋ shiiyɛ tɛ yi bakala le yuufe ncho bafɛɛ bɛŋ sâge chikfuu chi Ishwala chi yuufe ncho chifɛɛ.

Muh wuchii wù le wu chinɛ la che le, kɛnɛ booŋ ba bwee le, kɛnɛ jɛ́me ye le, kɛnɛ chiji le, kɛnɛ bwee le, kɛnɛ booŋ le, kɛnɛ ŋɛɛ le, wu chinɛ nje mɛ, tu wu lé wu kɛ̂mɛ bamii bɛ mwɛɛ kiŋgane gwii fede no wu gɛ̀ kɛme. Wu lé wu kɛ̂mɛ tɛ kinche kì kage gɛ.
Geenɛ, bamii ba duude ba le fwe mɛɛse lé bo gê bo tu ajiŋ, ba duude ba le ajiŋ mɛɛse lé bo gê bo nyu fwe.”

footnotes.text: Nyambala yinɛ le ba tɛŋe a jɛ́ yi bala le lɛ “camel”.
